draft_notes.explanation: Read contiguous ladder lengths and rung counts from the three level colours. Compare two rules against every demonstration: length rank (native) and rung count (archived interpretation). Reject contradictory or query-ambiguous contexts; never default to rank. Climber position follows which ladders reach the next level. Emit output in visible coordinates using D4-specialized affine cell placement, without inverse-grid wrappers.
draft_notes.limitations: Native21x21domain with four differently coloured levels, three ladders, one climber and a complete bottom ladder. Output layout and semantic colours are specialized by episode augmentation. Evidence distinguishes rank from rungs only, not all possible ARC rules. Native all-equal lengths are3,4,5; worker examples6/7cannot fit native row constraints.
